note: Elk Island National Park, in the Astotin Lake Recreation Area, overlooking a marsh and walking distance to the beach. Raised gravel camping pads. A walk-in tent area and oTENTiks share the campground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Parks Canada's Astotin page (modified 2026-09-28), fees page and hours page: 75 non-serviced reservable sites, C$31.75 (overflow C$19.50), park entry C$10 an adult a day; showers, flush toilets, taps, dump. Season written as approx. May 15 - Oct 12 (mid-May to Thanksgiving). Derived max_rig_ft 26 cleared (page: limited sites for units over 27 ft). Not waterfront confirmed; pin fine.
flags: PHONE: stored 1-877-737-3783 is the national reservation line. The park's own line on the page is the Visitor Centre 1-780-922-5790 ('call the Visitor Centre: 1-780-922-5790'). Recommend 780-922-5790.

WEBSITE: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/elkisland/activ/camping/astotin answered 200 and is this campground; https://reservation.pc.gc.ca is the generic reservation root (redundant with the federal:parks-canada row).

SITES: the derived pull_through true (note prose 'some pull-through') is neither confirmed nor contradicted by the page; left alone. The per-site catalogue (reservation.pc.gc.ca) was not read, so max length and pull-throughs are UNREAD.
POLICY ROW: nothing on these pages contradicts federal:parks-canada. Park entry here is C$10.00 adult / C$19.50 family (fees page modified 2025-12-01), inside the row's stated C$7.25-12.25 range.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): the campground loop sits in spruce east of the recreation-area road; Astotin Lake is ~450 m west across the road, day-use lawns and parking. The only water beside the loop is a ~1 ha marsh pond to the south-west (under 5 acres = no value) and a larger wetland east across the paved main park road. The page says 'Overlooking a picturesque marsh'.
PIN (53.67615,-112.82733): at the campground entrance junction; the loop centre is ~100 m east (about 53.6764,-112.8252). Within tolerance, no move.
